# Crates that may name payment instruction elements and payment account
# types (I-16, M3 design sections 2.4 rule 11 and 14.4).
# Checked by tools/deps-check (the `funds` rule): every other workspace
# crate fails when its source names a SEPA credit transfer element or a
# payment account type.
#
# Format: one crate name per line.
# Empty in M3. The M5 payment adapter crate is the first entry, and it must
# take its credentials from the tenant's vault.
